reference.construction: Exact Fraction branch and affine expressions from original IEEE bits and signed wire values; 90-digit Decimal power and standard clipping.
reference.criterion: Absolute error <= 1e-12 for this finite declared subset; exact IEEE identities. Not a universal error bound.

scope: Finite bounded scalar ICC parametric evaluations with a predeclared 1e-12 absolute criterion and exact identity bits; no universal error bound, parametric curve, profile model, transform, JPEG admission, compatibility, physical bound, or production claim.
